name: Project ArcoIris Build B4
description: Real-time Live View Luminance Histogram Engine + clean Exposure Simulation + Full Branding
features: Real-time 2,048-point Live View luminance histogram (64-bin resolution)
Dynamic peak auto-scaling with clip protection for shadows (bin 0) and highlights (bin 63)
Smoked-glass translucent YCbCr overlay in bottom-left screen area (x=16..147, y=324..391)
Tear-free per-frame LCD backbuffer injection right before DMA address flip at 0x0013598E
Unconditional Live View Exposure Simulation via NOP at 0x00222E5A
In-camera menu branding ('PROJECT ARCOIRIS', 'Project ArcoIris', 'MY MODS')

hook.convention: R0 carries newly rendered YCbCr 4:2:0 backbuffer address (0x96ED9B20 or 0x96F4A320)
